svg.title: Toolkit
svg.desc: languages & runtimes: TypeScript, Go, Python, Bun, Node.js. frontend: Next.js, React, TanStack Start, Astro, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui. platform & data: Cloudflare Workers, D1, Hono, Zod, Valibot, Vercel. dx & quality: mise, hk, oxlint, oxfmt, Vitest, Playwright. ci/cd & release: GitHub Actions, Renovate, semantic-release, zizmor. agentic & ai: Claude Code, Codex, MCP, AGENTS.md, agent skills. Now exploring: TypeScript 7, oxc, MCP servers, agent workflows, DX utilities. Always open to new frameworks, workflows, agentic tools and developer-experience utilities.
